note_on_traps: excel_schema_mapping (4 rows, live Excel surface) and template_invites (0 rows but queried in templateInviteService.js x3 + send-invite-email + send-email) were NOT candidates and were NOT touched, per the brief.

survey_sync_log.reason: 0 rows. No pg_proc/view/policy/trigger reference outside itself. No app-code reference in src/, supabase/functions/, agent-cli/. Only outbound FKs.

activity_log.reason: 0 rows. No DB-object reference. App-code hits are agent-cli test MOCKS only (agent-cli/lib/supabaseMock.mjs, lock-document-e2e.mjs, regress-idle-disappearance.mjs) which never touch the real table.

user_settings.reason: 0 rows. No DB-object reference. Zero app-code references anywhere.

annotations.reason: 0 rows. pg_proc text hits in kal48_create_revision/kal48_restore_revision are the JSONB key "annotations" and the DIFFERENT table document_annotations, not this table. Zero app-code references (app uses document_annotations).

survey_items.reason: LIVE DEPENDENCY: public.kal48_create_revision does SELECT ... FROM public.survey_items, and public.kal48_restore_revision does DELETE FROM / INSERT INTO public.survey_items. Dropping it breaks the KAL-48 document-revision create + restore feature. Also the inbound FK survey_sync_log_item_id_fkey.

spaces.reason: LIVE DEPENDENCY: public.get_current_usage has a "spaces_count" branch doing SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM spaces s JOIN documents d ON s.document_id = d.id. That is the quota/usage meter shipped in KAL-390 (commit 4a95ed94). Dropping it breaks the usage meter.

template_collaborators.reason: LIVE DEPENDENCY: public.user_can_access_template (an RLS helper) reads it; also public.kal31_accept_template_invite and public.purge_archived_template. AND the send-email edge function queries it at runtime via COLLABORATOR_TABLES (supabase/functions/send-email/index.ts:78,116 -> .from(table)). Dropping it breaks template sharing/access.
